Mark your calendars: Thee Liquor Cabinet is back and it's going full Y2K. 💿 Thee Liquor hosts a night of Total Request Drag chaos in the Lounge — think butterfly clips, low-rise everything, and heavy pours to match the hard hits. This is the early-2000s time capsule you didn't know you needed, cracked wide open for one night only. Dust off the fringe, charge your old flip phone for the aesthetic, and get ready for a lineup that's bringing the drama and the nostalgia in equal parts. Doors don't wait, and neither should you — this is the kind of night Pasco talks about for weeks after. 📌

Glitter, gloss, and a bassline straight out of 2003 — the Lounge is about to feel like a time machine. ✨ Thee Liquor Cabinet brings heavy pours and hard hits of drag, with Total Request Drag turning every request into a full-blown moment. Picture crimped hair catching the light, low-rise silhouettes strutting past, lace and leather and butterfly clips colliding in the best possible way. The energy builds with every song, every pour, every look that hits harder than the last. This is a night you feel in your chest before you even step inside — the kind of chaos that's pure fun from open to last call. Come lose yourself in the nostalgia. 💫

Total Request Drag means the crowd shapes the night, and everybody's part of the moment — no sidelines here. Pasco's Latinx-forward dance floor turns into a full-throwback playground where low-rise jeans meet lace gloves meet whatever era-defining fit you've been saving. Bring your people, bring your best 2003 fit, and let the pours be heavy and the hits harder. This is a night for showing up exactly as extra as you want to be. 💖
